hero.headline: Grow your wealth with the right mutual funds
hero.subline: An AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor helping you invest with clarity, discipline and personal service.

whyChooseUs.title: AMFI-registered
whyChooseUs.text: We are an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-372611) and follow the AMFI code of conduct.

whyChooseUs.title: Dedicated relationship manager
whyChooseUs.text: A named relationship manager who knows your family's goals and is a call or message away.

whyChooseUs.title: One dashboard for all your funds
whyChooseUs.text: Track holdings, SIPs, goals and capital gains for your whole family in one secure place.

whyChooseUs.title: Paperless investing
whyChooseUs.text: Complete KYC, start SIPs and place orders online with OTP authentication - no forms, no couriers.

howItWorks.title: Talk to us
howItWorks.text: Book a free consultation. We understand your goals and explain the scheme options and their risks.

howItWorks.title: Complete KYC
howItWorks.text: Complete your KYC online in a few minutes with your PAN, Aadhaar and a selfie.

howItWorks.title: Start investing and track online
howItWorks.text: Start SIPs or lump-sum investments and track everything on your dashboard.
